text:
noah_content: Heads upwe're doing a micro-launch for the "OSS refapp cookbook" next Thursday. Want to test variant copy for the blog post. Two intros: friendly vs technical. Thoughts?

irene_devrel: friendly: "Build with Redwood in minutes" technical: "Production inference patterns and refapp code". Could test both as social captions too.

noah_content: love it. plan: blog + 3 micro-tutorials + a single benchmark highlight. Ads will be low spend. Key is organic traction.

tom_research: I can surface one benchmark table: throughput and cost for small/medium/batch workloads. Will validate numbers by Wed.

ada_design: I'll prepare two header images to match the two intros. Also need a 1200x628 social card.

signupbot: New signups will trigger welcome email template ID: 77.

noah_content: inbound routing: if someone opts into "case study" on the post, route to content-partners@redwood.ai and tag in HubSpot as "cookbook_case_study". who can add mapping?

irene_devrel: I can add the mapping and hook the HubSpot API key.

noah_content: ok timeline: Tue final copy, Wed assets, Thu publish. also plan to push short clips to LinkedIn + Mastodon. Keep captions under 140 chars.

ada_design: will have variants by Wed morning.

irene_devrel: I'll prepare the code samples and ensure they run on gh actions.

noah_content: great. small performance note for the blog: include the hero stat like ">50% cost reduction with batching" but be ready to back it up in the appendix.

tom_research: will add a small methodology section.

noah_content: perfect, thanks team. will post final preview to #marketing-review before publishing.
